title: ElevenLabs TTS Eleven v4
description: Generate expressive speech with Eleven v4 from ElevenLabs. Control delivery with audio tags, voice stability, similarity settings, and IPA pronunciation.

inputs.name: text
inputs.tooltip: The text to convert to speech. Supports audio tags such as [whispering] and IPA pronunciation enclosed in forward slashes.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.tooltip: The voice to use for speech generation Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: stability
inputs.tooltip: Voice stability. Lower values allow more expressive delivery; higher values make delivery more consistent.

inputs.name: similarity_boost
inputs.tooltip: How closely the output follows the reference voice. Higher values increase similarity but may reduce naturalness.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Seed for best-effort reproducibility. Identical output is not guaranteed. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.tooltip: Language code (ISO 639-1) for speech generation and text normalization. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate.

inputs.name: apply_text_normalization
inputs.tooltip: Whether to normalize text such as numbers and dates before generation.

inputs.name: timestamps
inputs.tooltip: Whether to return character-level timing information with the generated audio.
